source.author: verg
source.text: Morere et fratrem ne desere frater.
source.text_original: Morere et fratrem ne desere frater.'
source.text_english: Die, and do not abandon your brother, brother.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: sic amplexu, sic pectora fratris, Iuno, tene; tuque o puppem ne desere, Pallas:
reuse.text_original: sic amplexu, sic pectora fratris, / Iuno, tene; tuque o puppem ne desere, Pallas: /
reuse.text_english: Thus, Juno, hold him in your embrace, thus his brother’s breast; and you too, Pallas, do not abandon the ship.
